summary: Migrated 52 real-code inline os.environ.get("MAC_*") calls in src/mac/task_executor.py to typed accessors from mac.env_config (env_str, env_bool, resolve_env_chain, resolve_hub_agent). Added import of env_config functions. Heredoc string literals (lines 4161-4531, 4552-4754) and dynamic-name lookups left unchanged by design. 144/146 tests pass (2 pre-existing env-specific sandbox failures); full contract suite passes at 93.01% statement / 84.41% branch coverage above both floors.

codegraph.note: Changes are backward-compatible typed accessor wrappers with identical runtime behavior; all affected tests pass

changes.description: 52 MAC_* inline os.environ.get calls migrated to env_config typed accessors. Import added: from mac.env_config import env_bool, env_int, env_str, resolve_env_chain, resolve_hub_agent. 21 os.environ.get calls intentionally preserved: 14 in heredoc string literals (standalone subprocess code), 4 dynamic-name lookups, 3 non-MAC_* variables (OPENAI_BASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, PATH).

assumptions: Bootstrap was already complete (.venv/bin/python and .venv/bin/pytest were present in the sandbox worktree).
The two pre-existing failures in test_task_executor.py are environment-specific (SSH unavailable, MAC_TASK_REPO_DEFAULT_BRANCH env leak) and are not caused by this migration.
Heredoc string literals (raw Python code running as subprocesses) cannot import mac.env_config and are intentionally left unchanged.
Dynamic env var name lookups (os.environ.get(name) where name is computed) are intentionally left unchanged as env_config requires a string literal name.
Push to remote is delegated to the deterministic host finalizer per repository runtime contract - no GitHub credentials available in sandbox.
